title: MITRE ENGAGE Schema v1.0
description: JSON Schema definitions for MITRE ENGAGE standard. ENGAGE provides a framework for defender adversary engagement operations including deception, denial, and detection activities aligned with strategic and engagement goals.

activity.title: ENGAGE Activity
activity.description: Engagement activity from MITRE ENGAGE representing a specific collection, detection, prevention, direction, disruption, reassurance, motivation, planning, or analysis action that defenders can take.

id.description: Unique ENGAGE activity identifier in format EACxxxx (e.g., EAC0001)

name.description: Human-readable name of the engagement activity

description.description: Short description of the activity (1-2 sentences)

long_description.description: Detailed description of the activity with examples and use cases

goals.description: Goal IDs that this activity supports (e.g., EGO0001, SGO0001)

eav.description: Description of the adversary vulnerability this activity can exploit

vulnerabilities.description: Engagement Adversarial Vulnerabilities (EAVs) that this activity exploits

attack_tactics.description: ATT&CK tactic(s) associated with this technique

attack_techniques.description: ATT&CK techniques that this activity can engage with or detect

approach.title: ENGAGE Approach
approach.description: Engagement approach from MITRE ENGAGE representing a strategic collection, detection, or tactical activity type that aligns with specific goals.

id.description: Unique ENGAGE approach identifier in format EAPxxxx or SAPxxxx (e.g., EAP0001, SAP0001)

description.description: Short description of the approach (1-2 sentences)

long_description.description: Detailed description of the approach with strategic context

goal.title: ENGAGE Goal
goal.description: Strategic or engagement goal from MITRE ENGAGE representing high-level objectives for adversary engagement operations.

id.description: Unique ENGAGE goal identifier in format EGOxxxx (Engagement Goal) or SGOxxxx (Strategic Goal)

long_description.description: Detailed description of the goal with strategic context and sub-goals

goal_type.description: Type of goal (Engagement Goal for tactical operations, Strategic Goal for long-term planning)

reference.title: ENGAGE Reference
reference.description: External reference (academic paper, documentation, etc.) linked to ENGAGE activities.

id.description: Unique reference identifier in format REFxxxx (e.g., REF0001)

title.description: Title of the reference (paper, article, documentation)

url.description: URL to the reference material (DOI, arxiv, or documentation link)

activity_id.description: ENGAGE activity ID that this reference supports or documents

mapping.title: ENGAGE Mapping
mapping.description: Mapping relationship between ENGAGE components and external frameworks (ATT&CK, etc.).

source_id.description: Source entity ID (e.g., goal_id, approach_id, activity_id)

target_id.description: Target entity ID (e.g., approach_id, attack_id, eav_id)
